sights.n: Nirai Kanai Bridge overlook (ニライカナイ橋)
sights.w: A sweeping U-shaped road bridge that switchbacks down the Chinen hillside with the Pacific and Kudaka Island ahead — best seen from the tunnel-top viewpoint. It appears in the 2021 anime 'The Aquatope on White Sand', which earned Nanjō a place among the Anime Tourism Association's 88 anime pilgrimage sites.
sights.anime: The Aquatope on White Sand (白い砂のアクアトープ, 2021) — bridge shown in the series; Nanjō named an 'Anime Pilgrimage 88' site

sights.n: Kouri Ōhashi Bridge & Kouri Island (古宇利大橋・古宇利島)
sights.w: The 1,960 m toll-free bridge (2005) from Yagaji Island across emerald shallows to Kouri, the 'Island of Love' — one of Okinawa's signature drives, with beaches, Heart Rock and garlic-shrimp trucks at the far end.
